links.comparator_used: Initial AI responses with a default prompt, without a structured prompt targeting readability
links.outcome: Readability (FKGL and FRE) of AI-generated CKD patient education responses
links.effect: ChatGPT FKGL 11.34 to 7.87 and FRE 36.17 to 64.23; Gemini FKGL 9.62 to 7.13 and FRE 46.36 to 61.45 (about 7th-grade level)
links.quote: However, when a structured prompt was applied, AI responses demonstrated significant improvements in readability, reducing the required literacy level to approximately the 7th-grade (ChatGPT FKGL: 7.87, FRE: 64.23; Gemini FKGL: 7.13, FRE: 61.45).
